objective: Independent external evaluation of the current hydrogen release/inventory-depletion physics against a separate PRESLHY Cryostat part-B experiment archive.
claim_boundary: This protocol evaluates rigid-source discharge and transient jet characteristics for the published ambient-temperature subset of the Cryostat part-B experiments. It does not validate cryogenic two-phase flow, ignition, dispersion, flame/radiation, station control, refuelling, or emergency separation distance.

source.title: PRESLHY Experiment series 3.1, part B
source.public_data_description: 12 free-field Cryostat hydrogen blow-down experiments; ambient-temperature and cryogenic tests; pressure, discharge and transient-jet/electrostatic measurements.

include: numerical time-series files from the part-B archive
ambient-temperature experiments only when the recorded gas temperature and release conditions are usable
at least 20 synchronized pressure samples after release start
exclude: cryogenic liquid-hydrogen tests from the primary ambient claim
files with no identifiable release start

analysis_rules: Freeze the archive URL, metadata, model commit and inclusion rules before downloading or opening numerical files.
Do not tune parameters, thresholds, source selection or time alignment after numerical outcomes are opened.
Report every eligible case and every failure.
If the archive lacks usable ambient synchronized traces, retain a negative data-availability result rather than substituting plot digitization.
next_action: Download and inspect only after this protocol is committed; if eligible ambient cases are found, run the frozen current model and retain a signed result.
